contactReps.subject: URGENT CONSTITUENT NOTICE: OPPOSE CANNABIS & HEMP BEVERAGE BAN IN TEXAS
contactReps.body:
Dear Honorable Texas Lawmaker,

I am writing as a concerned Texas voter to express my strong opposition to any proposed bans or criminalization of low-dose consumable hemp and cannabis beverages (including 5mg and 10mg Delta-9 THC products) in Texas.

Millions of Texans responsibly choose these lab-tested beverages as a safer alternative to alcohol and prescription medications. Banning these products will ruin hundreds of Texas small businesses, eliminate thousands of jobs, strip away vital tax revenue, and infringe on personal freedoms.

Rather than passing prohibition, Texas should enact sensible regulations and support opening Texas's first official legal adult-use cannabis dispensaries.

Please vote NO on any consumable hemp ban and stand up for Texas consumer choice and economic freedom!

Sincerely,
A Concerned Texas Citizen & Voter

title: Justice for Rusty
description: On May 31, 2024, CDL driver Rusty Moore was unlawfully arrested by the Little Falls Police Department and Minnesota State Troopers. This traffic stop went viral, drawing millions of views. The arrest caused him to miss his daughter's graduation, lose his job, and face a lifetime revocation of his Commercial Driver's License (CDL). Rusty is appealing this decision in the Minnesota Court of Appeals. This fundraiser helps support his civil rights attorney legal fees, ongoing car expenses (including mandatory interlock device fees), medical costs, and basic living expenses while fighting for accountability and justice against police misconduct.

title: BROWSER AGE API PETITION: ADD AGE TO THE BROWSER
description: A petition & web standard advocacy campaign to add a native Browser Age API to web browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox). Users verify their identity once in the browser (via Google, Apple Secure Enclave, or ID), and browsers cryptographically share zero-knowledge age verification. By default, it delivers just the birth year (or 18+/21+ proof) to websites. Only high-security services (like banks) can request permissioned access to exact month and day—ending repetitive age gates, honeypots, and data tracking forever!

contactReps.subject: PETITION: IMPLEMENT NATIVE BROWSER AGE API (ZERO-KNOWLEDGE AGE VERIFICATION STANDARD)
contactReps.body:
To W3C Web Standards Committees, Major Browser Engineers, and Digital Rights Regulators,

I am signing this petition and constituent demand to standardize a privacy-first Browser Age API across modern web browsers.

Every day, internet users are forced to manually enter their birthdates or upload sensitive government IDs to third-party websites just to pass age verification gates. This creates massive honeypots of personal data, exposes users to identity theft, and creates unnecessary friction.

We demand a native, open Browser Age API built directly into web browsers:
1. ONE-TIME VERIFICATION: Users verify their age once in their browser (via Google, Apple Secure Enclave, or Government ID).
2. PRIVACY BY DEFAULT: Websites only receive a cryptographically signed birth year or age-gate boolean (e.g. 18+ / 21+) without accessing exact birth dates.
3. SECURE ZERO-KNOWLEDGE PROOFS: Only high-security institutions (like banks) can request permissioned access to exact month/day/year.
4. CRYPTOGRAPHIC PROOFS: Eliminate third-party tracking while providing verifiable proof of age.

Stop forcing us to re-enter our birthdates everywhere. Add Age to the Browser!

Sincerely,
A Concerned Internet User & Digital Privacy Advocate
